theorems.name: Unique normalized quarter-turn-invariant quadratic form
theorems.statement: If q(x,y)=a*x^2+2*b*x*y+c*y^2 is invariant under (x,y)->(-y,x) and q(1,0)=1, then a=c=1 and b=0.

theorems.name: Character norm multiplicativity
theorems.statement: For J^2=-1, the coordinate norm x^2+y^2 is multiplicative under (x+yJ)(u+vJ).

theorems.name: Algebraic chord-mesh decay
theorems.statement: For the chirality-selected root tower, tau_(n+1)<tau_n/2 and ||K_n-1||<4*tau_1/2^n, so the mesh tends to zero without an angle coordinate.

theorems.name: Dense finite rotor subgroup
theorems.statement: The nested union D of cyclic rotor groups D_n=<K_n> is dense in the uniquely normalized unit character conic because its maximum chord mesh tends to zero.

theorems.name: Unique metric group completion
theorems.statement: The metric completion of D is uniquely S_J^1; multiplication and inversion extend uniquely, so after J->i the completion is U(1).

theorems.name: Finite phase fraction compatibility
theorems.statement: The phase coordinate k/(6*2^n) is preserved by the refinement (k,N)->(2k,2N).

theorems.name: Intrinsic polygonal phase length
theorems.statement: Refining the polygonal path to a finite state of phase q gives length converging to 2Lq, because the full polygon perimeter converges to 2L.

theorems.name: Unique continuous Euler character
theorems.statement: The homomorphism on the dense phase subgroup extends uniquely to Exp_J:R->S_J^1 with kernel 2LZ, Exp_J(L)=-1 and Exp_J(L/2)=J.

theorems.name: Intrinsic Euler decomposition
theorems.statement: Defining C_L and S_L as reversal-even and reversal-odd coordinates of Exp_J gives Exp_J(t)=C_L(t)+J*S_L(t), the addition formulas and C_L^2+S_L^2=1.

theorems.name: Cell-rooted Euler identity
theorems.statement: The Cell polygon theorem gives L=pi, hence Exp_J(pi)=-1 and, under J->i, e^(i*pi)+1=0.

theorems.name: Cell-rooted Viete product
theorems.statement: With c_1=sqrt(3)/2 and c_(n+1)=sqrt((1+c_n)/2), one has 3/pi=product_(n>=2)c_n.

theorems.name: Geometric-harmonic polygon renormalization
theorems.statement: For inner/outer bounds a_n,b_n, a_(n+1)^2=a_n*b_n and b_(n+1)(a_(n+1)+b_n)=2*a_(n+1)*b_n.
